name: Wen Liang
source: You can always find Wen at the gym or at the bar, emptying bottle after bottle of beer. Those are his two passions: martial arts and drinking, and maybe also fucking around with people. Despite his short stature, he's built like a tank and was a high-caliber competitor when he was younger.
